principle: Third-party software/data keep their own licences. The public source release contains only our code/config/docs; large third-party datasets are fetched at runtime or supplied externally. Aggregator claims are never promoted without source-level provenance.

OpenAI_API.license_or_terms: External API service; no API key or service code redistributed.
OpenAI_API.redistribution_strategy: BYO API key only; store=false; sanitized research envelope; no raw VCF/genotypes/patient identifiers.

Open_Targets.license_or_terms: Platform marked CC0 1.0; code is open-source under repository-specific licences.
Open_Targets.redistribution_strategy: Prefer runtime API/download with provenance. Do not silently relicense embedded upstream evidence.

Reactome.license_or_terms: Database data and derived data files CC0; most software Apache-2.0; illustrations/branding CC BY 4.0; some code may have dependency-specific copyleft.
Reactome.redistribution_strategy: Use pathway/interaction data through runtime API or official downloads; preserve provenance.

Ensembl_VEP.redistribution_strategy: External tool installed separately from official upstream.

AlphaFold_DB.license_or_terms: AlphaFold DB prediction data CC BY 4.0; academic and commercial use explicitly permitted by AFDB. AF2 code Apache-2.0; model parameters CC BY 4.0.
AlphaFold_DB.redistribution_strategy: Runtime retrieval of selected structure/PAE files only. Preserve AFDB/DeepMind/EMBL-EBI attribution, source URL, accession and retrieval date. Do not claim clinical validation or warranty; do not bundle unrelated mirrored databases.

AlphaMissense.license_or_terms: CONFLICT: current DeepMind/Ensembl/AlphaFold DB documentation states CC BY 4.0, but the actual official AlphaMissense_hg38.tsv.gz file header states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and an EMBL-EBI 2023 page also describes non-commercial terms.
AlphaMissense.redistribution_strategy: Implemented as an optional external research adapter only. Disabled in Challenge/public/commercial baseline. Do not download, redistribute, embed scores, or use for a submission artifact until rights-holder clarification resolves the conflicting official notices.

DGIdb.license_or_terms: DGIdb v5 software MIT. DGIdb aggregates claims from many upstream knowledgebases/publications with source-specific terms.
DGIdb.commercial_use: software yes; individual aggregated claims depend on upstream source
DGIdb.redistribution_strategy: Use DGIdb only as a discovery/index channel. Persist source names/PMIDs. A DGIdb-only interaction cannot become submission evidence until verified in a primary/public source whose reuse terms are compatible.

ClinVar.license_or_terms: NCBI public resource; source assertions remain third-party submissions.
ClinVar.redistribution_strategy: Official download/runtime use with provenance; do not present assertions as independently validated.

ChEMBL.redistribution_strategy: Download separately and retain ChEMBL provenance/share-alike obligations. Do not relicense or bundle an adapted ChEMBL database inside the CC-BY source archive.

gnomAD.redistribution_strategy: Official runtime download; no bulk database redistribution in source release.

HPO.redistribution_strategy: Official runtime download; preserve attribution/version and source-file integrity.

Pangolin.redistribution_strategy: Independent external process; do not relicense as CC-BY.

PK-Sim.redistribution_strategy: Independent external program/adapter; model inputs need their own provenance.

Illumina_SpliceAI.redistribution_strategy: Excluded from free/open baseline because upstream software/model terms do not match the required profile.

Enrichr_LINCS_GEO.redistribution_strategy: Excluded from default V3 profile until source-specific use and redistribution rights are qualified.
